# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Project Context

This repository contains the eligiable Visa Appointment Monitoring System.

It is a Python-based visa appointment monitoring and notification platform.

Read the following documentation before making substantial changes:

- README.md
- PROJECT_BRIEF.md
- ARCHITECTURE.md
- COMPLIANCE.md
- IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
- AGENTS.md

## Coding Requirements

Use:

- Python.
- FastAPI.
- SQLAlchemy.
- PostgreSQL.
- Alembic.
- Pydantic.
- HTTPX.
- Pytest.
- Docker.

Use type annotations and clear function names.

Follow PEP 8.

Keep components modular and independently testable.

## Architecture

Separate:

- API endpoints.
- Database models.
- Business services.
- Provider adapters.
- Monitoring scheduler.
- Notification services.
- Configuration.
- Security.

Avoid putting business logic directly into API routes.

## Dashboard Management Scope

The dashboard supports administrator-only staff-account creation and
monitoring-job configuration. Keep public registration disabled, hash
passwords, enforce role checks and CSRF, validate reference relationships, and
audit administrative changes. Staff may view operations and record manual
verification but may not administer accounts or jobs.

Job configuration must never bypass provider permission checks or change a
provider from manual-only. Providers remain seed-managed. Alerts, notifications
and system errors are generated by application activity rather than manually
created through dashboard forms. Run monitoring jobs in a dedicated worker
process separate from the FastAPI web service.

## Visa Provider Integrations

Implement separate adapters for:

- VFS Global.
- BLS International.
- TLScontact.

Do not assume automated access is permitted.

Use manual-check fallback when provider access is restricted or permission is unverified.

Never fabricate official APIs.

## Compliance Restrictions

Do not implement:

- CAPTCHA solving or bypass.
- Queue bypass.
- Session spoofing.
- IP rotation to evade restrictions.
- Unauthorized login automation.
- Anti-bot evasion.
- Unauthorized private endpoint access.

Respect provider terms, applicable robots.txt directives and rate limits.

## Availability Detection

Only verified AVAILABLE results can trigger appointment alerts.

Do not alert on UNKNOWN, SOURCE_ERROR or MANUAL_CHECK_REQUIRED.

Implement transition-based alerting, deduplication and cooldown.

## Notifications

Support:

- Telegram Bot API.
- SMTP email.

Use environment variables for credentials.

Record notification delivery results.

## Testing

Use Pytest.

Mock external providers.

Test:

- Provider adapters.
- Change detection.
- Deduplication.
- Cooldown.
- Notification delivery.
- Error handling.
- Manual-check fallback.
- API endpoints.

## Development Practices

Before editing:

- Inspect relevant existing files.
- Preserve working functionality.
- Follow the documented architecture.
- Make focused changes.
- Add tests.
- Run relevant tests.
- Explain significant changes.

Do not introduce unnecessary frameworks or dependencies.

Do not overwrite project configuration without checking its existing contents.

Prioritize security, correctness and maintainability.
